welcome: Welcome to The Ridge. Light the fire, run a bath under the stars and watch the ranges change colour. We hope it is a slow, quiet stay.

rules.title: Quiet hours
rules.body: Please keep noise down from 10pm to 7am. Sound carries a long way across the ridge.

rules.title: Fire safety
rules.body: Use the wood fire only with the screen closed. Never leave it burning when you go out or go to bed.

rules.title: No smoking
rules.body: No smoking or vaping inside. Please put out any butts fully, as the bush is dry and grassy.

rules.title: Guests and parties
rules.body: The cabin is for the two guests on your booking. No parties or events, and no extra overnight guests.

rules.title: Wildlife
rules.body: Do not feed the wildlife. Keep food and bins closed so possums and bush turkeys stay away.

howto.title: Wi-Fi, door code and air con
howto.body: Find these on the TV, or scan its QR code to open them on your phone.

howto.title: Wood fire
howto.body: Open the vent, place kindling and firelighters under two logs, then light. Close the screen once it is going. Let ashes cool and leave them.

howto.title: Outdoor bath
howto.body: Fill the bath, check the temperature with your hand, and relax. Please drain and rinse it before you leave.

howto.title: Rubbish and recycling
howto.body: Put rubbish and recycling in the separate bins. Please do not leave food outside overnight.

items.name: Bangalow Hotel
items.note: Classic country pub with hearty meals and cold drinks. Good for a relaxed dinner.

items.name: Ciao, Mate!
items.note: Woodfired pizza in Bangalow. Casual and good to share.

items.name: The Eltham Hotel
items.note: Hinterland pub with a country feel, a short scenic drive away.

items.name: Butcher Baker
items.note: Byron Street spot for breakfast, lunch and pastries in Bangalow.

items.name: Bangalow Farmers Market
items.note: Saturday mornings in Piccabeen Park. Local food, coffee and breakfast stalls.

items.name: Mullum Farmers Market
items.note: Held on Fridays. Fresh produce, baked goods and live music.

items.name: The Crystal Castle
items.note: Gardens, giant crystals, a labyrinth and a cafe at 81 Monet Drive.

items.name: Minyon Falls
items.note: Rainforest lookout and waterfall in Whian Whian State Forest. Check track conditions before you go.

items.name: Moonshine Coffee Federal
items.note: Specialty coffee and good food in Federal village.

items.name: Sparrow Coffee
items.note: Take-away coffee on Byron Street, Bangalow.

items.name: The Bangalow Bread Co.
items.note: Good coffee and baked goods on Byron Street.

items.name: Brunswick Valley Historical Society Museum
items.note: A look at local history when the weather is wet.

items.name: The Crystal Castle cafe and bookshop
items.note: Browse the bookshop and have a bite under cover.

items.name: Zentvelds Coffee
items.note: Providore that brews coffee on site. Handy for beans and treats.

steps: Strip the beds and leave the linen in a pile
Make sure the fire is fully out and cool
Drain and rinse the outdoor bath
Put all rubbish and recycling in the bins
Turn off lights and the air conditioning
Lock up using the door code on the TV

emergency.name: Byron Central Hospital (24 hour Emergency Department), 54 Ewingsdale Road, Ewingsdale
